verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent evaluation and simulation platform, so a prompt playground is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never documents one. The closest material is registering agent versions (which records instructions and model) and comparing those versions on tasks in browser-run evaluations. That is adjacent version-comparison tooling, not interactive prompt iteration against real models with variables.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
